text.content:
AWOL colonel, warlord of the Occupied Zone.

Role: Warlord (Solo 9)
Affiliation: Barghest Militia; formerly Colonel, NUSA Army
Where to find them: EBM Petrochem Stadium; Black Sapphire, the Occupied Zone
Known for: Operation Midnight Storm; refusing to withdraw after the Arvin Accord

Colonel Hansen led Barghest, the NUSA 4th Army's urban combat and pacification unit, at the point of the Unification War, and took the EBM Petrochem Stadium in Operation Midnight Storm. When the Arvin Accord ordered the NUSA home, he ignored the order and kept his troops, his armor and the half-built stadium district. Washington declared him AWOL.

He is calm, polite and very patient, gives speeches from the stadium's press box, and believes the city will need him. Fury, who walked Lyle Thompson through Pacifica, says he will still be there in ten years: he isn't waiting the city out, he's building.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.19; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 04, 12
